method: Opened both original current PNGs, both native frozen-reference PNGs and both labelled native comparison PNGs through the image viewer. No crop, recolour, image editing, generated replacement or metadata relabelling was used. Independently measured SHA-256 for each new current image and its original 2d88 counterpart.

browserDiagnostics.notes: Original records retain deployment.json HTTP 404 while true final preparation has not run, two resource-error console entries, and ReadPixels GPU-stall warnings. No application export failure occurred.

frames.equalityScope: Only this actual newly captured PNG and its named original 2d88 PNG; no extrapolation to other views or main-city images.
observedImprovement: The closed graphite upper nose now has a visible lit surface distinct from the actual lower intake.
Wheel faces, thinner split spokes, rim edges and aerosectors read as separate grey/metal surfaces instead of nearly solid black blades.
The glazing is visibly translucent and its highlights are softer; some interior geometry is visible through it.
remainingLimitations: The nose still occupies a broad rectangular silhouette, and its lower intake remains strongly black. The view does not establish a fully curved OEM front fascia.
Shoulder and door planes remain angular; the small curvature edits are less pronounced than the wheel and glass changes.
Studio framing and grey surroundings show material/shape differences, not final city photography quality.

frames.equalityScope: Only this actual newly captured PNG and its named original 2d88 PNG; no extrapolation to other views or main-city images.
observedImprovement: The previous solid black upper occlusion is removed. The pillar/roof-bar boundaries and independent dark studio background are visible.
The left-hand wheel, dashboard top, door trim, seat and floor surfaces have readable boundaries under the same studio lights.
The experimental single-seat layout remains distinct from the separate two-seat reference configuration.
remainingLimitations: This is a wide technical cabin inspection camera, not the main driving eye point. Main-city cockpit evidence remains separate.
The dashboard screen, wheel, buttons, seat and rear equipment deck are visibly simplified; this is not OEM interior-detail certification.
The dark upper studio background is intentional background. It does not by itself prove city visibility; separate main-city images do that.

timeMeasurementLimit: productExportThroughToolSavedMs includes the product export, browser download and automation save. It is not isolated application encoding time or GPU performance.
scopeExclusions: All other 30 old inspection PNGs remain original captures under conditional dependency review; they are not labelled new 28e9 images.
Original main-city cockpit images and all UI/controls/research evidence use their own capture or source-inheritance records.
AAA completion, OEM surface fidelity, hardware GPU performance and real-user handling are not established.
